title: Home Sweet Void
summary: After the cockpit cruise they are inside. Greeting is the jumbo Earth marshmallow bag on the glass table. Conversation (space speeding) starts before the floor. White asteroid-ride worms sneak the baseboard, sit up as a cut, and hog the scene. The white building cat speaks once and is stopped by glow, not a beam. Daisy, Hanshaw, and the bird joke remain this week's musical spine — this packet waits its turn for Imagine generation.
visualArc: Pad into table / bag down → marshmallow talk → floor sneak → one head turns → hard cut to seated hog → Earth coffee-house cup → cat glow-stop → bag was here first.
